S7 Class for the Information Chosen Against the Family

Source: R/information.R
AutoInfo.Rd

AutoInfo is the class of the object that auto_info() returns: an information whose matrix, observed or expected, is settled once the family is known. It inherits from distributions7::Information, the abstract parent of distributions7::ObservedInfo and distributions7::ExpectedInfo. Use auto_info(), which validates its arguments; the class is exported so that S7::S7_inherits() can test an object. information_objects compares the three objects.

Usage

AutoInfo(method = NULL, repair_floor = integer(0))

Arguments

method

NULL or an object that inherits from distributions7::ExpectMethod, the method that obtains the expected information wherever the settled choice or the fallback uses it. NULL selects the closed form of the family where it has one and distributions7::expect_opg() otherwise.

repair_floor

A single positive number, the relative floor of the repair of an indefinite observed information.

Value

An S7 object of class AutoInfo, which inherits from distributions7::Information, with the properties method and repair_floor.

See also

auto_info() for the constructor and information_objects for the comparison with distributions7::observed_info() and distributions7::expected_info().

Examples

a <- auto_info(method = distributions7::expect_mc(nsim = 500))
S7::S7_inherits(a, distributions7::Information)
#> [1] TRUE
S7::S7_inherits(a, AutoInfo)
#> [1] TRUE
a@method
#> Expectation by Monte Carlo (nsim = 500)
